verdict.rationale: Bun documents a global package cache location (~/.bun/install/cache) with hardlink reuse, an offline mode that errors instead of touching the network when packages are cached, and --frozen-lockfile for reproducible installs — all directly enabling CI cache-restore + offline installs. However, there's no first-party CI-specific guide (e.g., GitHub Actions cache-restore recipe) or independent benchmark confirming CI speedups match local claims. missing for 10: dedicated CI/cache-restore tutorial, third-party CI performance validation.
